names.note: Read out of the Охридски пролог’s fourth heading for 6. децембар ст. ст., „Свети Теофил, епископ антиохијски.“ — «Свети» is “saint” and not a rank, and «епископ антиохијски» is the grade with the see, which §6 keeps out of a stored form; so the bare personal name is the whole of the form. THE FOLD THIS MAKES IS WRITTEN AND KEYED: `sr-foldnew.mjs` measured the string at two other holders, `theophilus-companion-of-trophimus` and `theophilus-of-selention`, so the key in `scripts/corpus-gate.mjs` goes from two members to three in this commit and the two-member key it replaces is deleted with its reading carried forward. The corpus keeps more than twenty Theophilus folders and the fold is three because only these three hold a Serbian form at all.

death.note: Охридски пролог за 6. децембар ст. ст.: „Управљао црквом Антиохијском тринаест година, и упокојио се 181. године.“ — he governed the church of Antioch thirteen years and reposed in 181. The thirteen years are a length and not a bound, so no `floruit` was built out of them by subtraction; the year of death is the one year the book prints.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 19.12.2025 (6. децембар ст. ст.) — „Свети Теофил, епископ антиохијски.“

attestations.note: The day’s fourth and last entry, and the second of this day’s two arrivals. Four lines: well schooled in Hellenic philosophy, he was baptised after reading the Holy Scripture and became a great protector of the Christian faith; his work «О вери», On the Faith, is preserved to this day; he governed the church of Antioch thirteen years and reposed in 181. `types`: `bishop` ALONE, and the restraint is deliberate — the vocabulary carries `apologist`, and a man who read himself into the faith out of philosophy, defended it and left a book about it reads like one, but «заштитник вере хришћанске» is a description and not a rank, and BRIEF-SERBIAN §5 makes the mapping a thing to read and not to assume. `dates`: death 181, the one year the book prints. The thirteen years of his episcopate are a length and no `floruit` was built out of them by subtraction. NO `office`: “Bishop of Antioch” is not in the four locale packs that `i18n.test.mjs` checks, so the see is in the display name and the life. NO `locations`. NO `related` row: the entry names nobody. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.
